LITBUY RESEARCH NOTE / WORKFLOW GUIDE

Litbuy warehouse stage: what to check before you build a parcel

Warehouse status is a planning stage. Use it to organise items, review available information and decide what should enter the same international parcel.

Independent guide. This page summarises publicly described Litbuy workflow features and practical checks. Availability, charges, routes and seller terms can change, so use the current order and parcel screens for a live decision.

Treat arrival as a checkpoint

When an item reaches the warehouse, it has moved beyond the initial purchase request but has not yet become an international parcel. This is the point to compare its recorded option, available QC images and notes from the original listing. Check each item on its own before making a shipping decision for the group.

Keep unlike items visible

It is tempting to combine every item as soon as it arrives. A clearer approach is to group items only after considering size, fragility, value and timing. A pair of shoes, a delicate accessory and a large electronic item can create different packing concerns.

Use stated warehouse controls

Litbuy’s public descriptions mention warehouse services, consolidation and extra packing options. Exact controls and charges can change, so use the current order screen for what is available to your account. Read each option description instead of assuming it applies automatically.
